events.note: In effect before the window opens, so it is reported at the first minute, 00:00 EDT. Horizons at 2026-10-01 04:00 UT: Mercury 210.900, Mars 121.785, Pluto 303.121, so Mercury squares Mars (89.1) and Pluto (92.2) while Mars opposes Pluto (181.3). Jessica Davidson's October 2026 forecast describes the same Mars-Pluto T-square.
events.summary: ➡️ ⊤ ♂️-♇-☿ Mars, Mercury, Pluto t-square forming (Mercury focal)

events.note: Forms when Venus-Mars enters the 6 degree square orb: Horizons puts Venus minus Mars at 96.0003 at 08:24 UT and 95.9999 at 08:25 UT. Venus-Pluto (84.7) and Mars-Pluto were already in orb when the window opened.
events.summary: ➡️ ⊤ ♂️-♇-♀️ Mars, Pluto, Venus t-square forming (Venus focal)
